name: Data Access Security Data Owner Election Campaign Task Waiting
description: Sent to each voter when a data owner election configured to send invitations starts, telling them how many resources are waiting for their vote.
subject: Action required: Pending data owner election campaign tasks
body:
Data owner election campaign task

Hi $__recipient.name,

As part of our efforts to strengthen our organization’s data security posture and the governance of sensitive data access, we have launched a campaign to identify owners for sensitive data assets.

You have been identified as one of the business stakeholders most active on one or more of these data assets.

You currently have $election.taskCount activities awaiting your input.

Please use the following link to view your data ownership election tasks in Data Access Security:

Pending Data Ownership Election Tasks

Thank you. This is an automatic message from Data Access Security; please do not reply.
